senses.gloss: (or קָפָא) name of a worm in herbs which causes disease of the bowels; (oth. opin.) a poisonous substance in vegetables.
units: Pes. 115ᵇ צריך לשקועיה … משום ק׳ you must dip the bitter herb into the ḥăroseth to counteract the effect of the ḳappa.
Ib. לא … וק׳ מריחא מיית it is not necessary to dip it, for the ḳ. dies from the smell (of the ḥăroseth).
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:11">Tosef. Ter. VII, 11</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="S01706"><he>קַפָּה</he></cite>.
